units.title: Business and management
units.intro: Grammar focus: Report language; 鉴于; 至于

items.en: to request help; to appeal (for help)

ex.zh: 她向我们大声求助。
ex.p: tā xiàng wǒ men dà shēng qiú zhù
ex.en: She called out to us for help.

ex.zh: 你可以向他求助。
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā qiú zhù
ex.en: You can ask him for help.

items.en: to work a shift; on duty
consistent; constant; from start to finish
to hold in safekeeping; to have in one's care; to guarantee

ex.zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
ex.p: yào shi nǐ lǎo dá yóu xì de huà nǐ de shì lì huì xià jiàng de
ex.en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.

ex.zh: 他的视力不佳。
ex.p: tā de shì lì bù jiā
ex.en: He has poor eyesight.

ex.zh: 我的家人每年冬天去滑雪。
ex.p: wǒ de jiā rén měi nián dōng tiān qù huá xuě
ex.en: My family goes skiing every winter.

ex.zh: 我之前不怎么想去滑雪。
ex.p: wǒ zhī qián bù zěn me xiǎng qù huá xuě
ex.en: I didn't really feel like going skiing.

ex.zh: 他的胃口很好。
ex.p: tā de wèi kǒu hěn hǎo
ex.en: He has a good appetite.

ex.zh: 多亏你我胃口都没了。
ex.p: duō kuī nǐ wǒ wèi kǒu dōu méi le
ex.en: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.

items.en: to gather; to collect; to harvest
to assist; to aid; supplementary; auxiliary

ex.zh: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。
ex.p: tā kāi shǐ duì shēng tài xué gǎn xìng qù shì shòu dào tā de yǐng xiǎng
ex.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.

items.en: to imagine; to assume; to envisage

ex.zh: 我有一个设想。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu yī gè shè xiǎng
ex.en: I had a vision.

items.en: to be reborn; to regenerate; to be a second so-and-so (famous dead person)

ex.zh: 你认为日本第二高峰是哪座山？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi rì běn dì èr gāo fēng shì nǎ zuò shān
ex.en: What mountain do you think is the second highest in Japan?

ex.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
ex.p: yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng
ex.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

ex.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。
ex.p: cóng yuè qiú shǎng kàn de huà dì qiú kàn qǐ lai xiàng gè pí qiú
ex.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.

items.en: to hide; to evade; to dodge

ex.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
ex.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

ex.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
ex.p: tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shi zhuō zi
ex.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

items.en: catalog; table of contents; directory (on computer hard drive)
to delay; to hold up; to waste time
to sprinkle; to drip; to pour

ex.zh: 我要一间有淋浴的单人间。
ex.p: wǒ yào yī jiān yǒu lín yù de shàn rén jiān
ex.en: I'd like a single with a shower, please.

ex.zh: 我想要冰激淋作甜点。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuō tián diǎn
ex.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

ex.zh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？
ex.p: nǐ jiàn dào jīn tiān zǎo shang de cǎi hóng le ma
ex.en: Did you see the rainbow this morning?

items.en: to recoil; to draw back; to fall back

ex.zh: 有时候，我们应该后退一步想一想。
ex.p: yǒu shí hou wǒ men yīng gāi hòu tuì yī bù xiǎng yī xiǎng
ex.en: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.

ex.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
ex.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
ex.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

items.en: branch; classifier for sticks, rods, pencils etc

ex.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。
ex.p: nǚ hái gěi le wǒ yī zhī hóng méi guī hé yī zhī bái méi guī
ex.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.

ex.zh: 他紧紧抓住树枝。
ex.p: tā jǐn jǐn zhuā zhù shù zhī
ex.en: He held on firmly to the branch.

ex.zh: 这次旅途下了三场雨。
ex.p: zhè cì lǚ tú xià le sān cháng yǔ
ex.en: It rained three times during the trip.

ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。
ex.p: zhù nǐ lǚ tú yú kuài
ex.en: I hope you have a good trip.

items.en: to model; to mold; (literature) to portray (in words)

ex.zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
ex.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi dé dào tā men gěi nǐ de xīn shuǐ
ex.en: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.

ex.zh: 他的低薪水让他买不了房。
ex.p: tā de dī xīn shuǐ ràng tā mǎi bù liǎo fáng
ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.

items.en: to weigh; to examine; to consider
used for 师傅 (in Taiwan); master; qualified worker
to transfer; to maneuver (troops etc); movement of personnel
to give guidance; to mentor; to counsel

ex.zh: 在建筑物里的所有人都感觉到了地震。
ex.p: zài jiàn zhù wù lǐ de suǒ yǒu rén dōu gǎn jué dào le dì zhèn
ex.en: Everybody in the building felt the earthquake.

items.en: to procure (for an enterprise etc); to purchase

sents.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng zài wǒ fù mǔ lái zhī qián shōu shi gān jìng wū zi
sents.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.

sents.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
sents.p: tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shi zhuō zi
sents.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

sents.zh: 我要一间有淋浴的单人间。
sents.p: wǒ yào yī jiān yǒu lín yù de shàn rén jiān
sents.en: I'd like a single with a shower, please.

sents.zh: 我想要冰激淋作甜点。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào bīng jī lín zuō tián diǎn
sents.en: I want ice cream for dessert.

sents.zh: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？
sents.p: nǐ jiàn dào jīn tiān zǎo shang de cǎi hóng le ma
sents.en: Did you see the rainbow this morning?

sents.zh: 有时候，我们应该后退一步想一想。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou wǒ men yīng gāi hòu tuì yī bù xiǎng yī xiǎng
sents.en: Once in a while, we should take a step back and think.

sents.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
sents.p: wǒ bù què dìng gāi qián jìn hái shi hòu tuì
sents.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.

sents.zh: 女孩给了我一枝红玫瑰和一枝白玫瑰。
sents.p: nǚ hái gěi le wǒ yī zhī hóng méi guī hé yī zhī bái méi guī
sents.en: The girl brought me a red and a white rose.

sents.zh: 他紧紧抓住树枝。
sents.p: tā jǐn jǐn zhuā zhù shù zhī
sents.en: He held on firmly to the branch.

sents.zh: 这次旅途下了三场雨。
sents.p: zhè cì lǚ tú xià le sān cháng yǔ
sents.en: It rained three times during the trip.

sents.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。
sents.p: zhù nǐ lǚ tú yú kuài
sents.en: I hope you have a good trip.

sents.zh: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
sents.p: nǐ bù yīng gāi dé dào tā men gěi nǐ de xīn shuǐ
sents.en: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.

sents.zh: 他的低薪水让他买不了房。
sents.p: tā de dī xīn shuǐ ràng tā mǎi bù liǎo fáng
sents.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.

sents.zh: 在建筑物里的所有人都感觉到了地震。
sents.p: zài jiàn zhù wù lǐ de suǒ yǒu rén dōu gǎn jué dào le dì zhèn
sents.en: Everybody in the building felt the earthquake.

units.intro: Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

ex.zh: 放眼全球，立足本土。
ex.p: fàng yǎn quán qiú lì zú běn tǔ
ex.en: Think globally, act locally.

items.en: to stop; to resist; to obstruct

ex.zh: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。
ex.p: wǒ hěn yí huò wèi shén me tiān qì biàn lěng de shí hou wǒ huì jué de hěn gū dān
ex.en: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.

ex.zh: 请给我们两把刀和四把叉。
ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ men liǎng bǎ dāo hé sì bǎ chā
ex.en: Give us two knives and four forks, please.

ex.zh: 叉子从桌上掉了下来。
ex.p: chā zi cóng zhuō shǎng diào le xià lai
ex.en: A fork fell off the table.

items.en: to delay; to put off; to procrastinate

ex.zh: 我不能再拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù néng zài tuō yán le
ex.en: I have to stop procrastinating.

ex.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le
ex.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

items.en: power switch; gas valve; to open the city (or frontier) gate

ex.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
ex.p: wǒ réng jiù wú fǎ xiāng xìn wǒ jū rán zuò le zhè zhǒng shì
ex.en: I still can't believe I did it.

ex.zh: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
ex.p: yǒu kōng de shí hou wǒ zǒng xǐ huan yǐn gǔ diǎn yīn yuè
ex.en: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.

ex.zh: 他够大方，借了我一点钱。
ex.p: tā gòu dà fāng jiè le wǒ yī diǎn qián
ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.

ex.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
ex.p: wǒ men de qián bù gòu suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ dìng dān qǔ xiāo le
ex.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.

ex.zh: 您决定好要下订单了吗？
ex.p: nín jué dìng hǎo yào xià dìng dān le ma
ex.en: Are you ready to order now?

ex.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。
ex.p: tā bèi rén fā xiàn dào zài chú fáng de dì bǎn shǎng bù shěng rén shì
ex.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.

ex.zh: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。
ex.p: yīng yǔ shì dāng jīn shì jiè shǎng yī zhǒng fēi cháng zhòng yào de yǔ yán
ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.

ex.zh: 他的主意总是可行的。
ex.p: tā de zhǔ yi zǒng shì kě xíng de
ex.en: His ideas are always practical.

items.en: to show; to take out and show to others; to display

ex.zh: 请出示您的票子。
ex.p: qǐng chū shì nín de piào zǐ
ex.en: Please show your ticket.

ex.zh: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
ex.p: hǎo jī jiān xiǎo wū bèi hóng shuǐ gū lì qǐ lai le
ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.

ex.zh: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。
ex.p: xǔ duō fáng wū bèi hóng shuǐ chōng zǒu le
ex.en: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.

items.en: to adapt; to rearrange; to revise
to absorb; to draw (a lesson, insight etc); to assimilate

ex.zh: 这件事至关重要。
ex.p: zhè jiàn shì zhì guān zhòng yào
ex.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.

ex.zh: 他们中的任何一位我都不认识。
ex.p: tā men zhōng de rèn hé yī wèi wǒ dōu bù rèn shi
ex.en: I know none of them.

ex.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。
ex.p: nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ guò qù rèn shi de yī gè nán hái
ex.en: You remind me of a boy I used to know.

items.en: from now on; in the future; time to come
unlikely to go so far as to; not as bad as

ex.zh: 我就当你夸我了。
ex.p: wǒ jiù dāng nǐ kuā wǒ le
ex.en: I'll take that as a compliment.

items.en: to dry (of weather, paint, cement etc); desiccation; dull
can't help (doing sth); can't refrain from

ex.zh: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。
ex.p: wǒ bù jīn xiǎng wǒ de ér zi yī zhí dōu zài shēng
ex.en: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.

items.en: to spend; to pay out; expenses; expenditure
to win a prize (in a lottery etc)
to solicit; to seek; to request (opinions, feedback etc)

ex.zh: 你应该向他征求意见。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi xiàng tā zhēng qiú yì jiàn
ex.en: You ought to ask him for advice.

items.en: to relate (a story or information); to tell or talk about; to recount

ex.zh: 详细叙述一下这起事故吧。
ex.p: xiáng xì xù shù yī xià zhè qǐ shì gù ba
ex.en: Describe that accident in detail.

units.title: Literature
units.intro: Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

items.en: the whole distance; from beginning to end

ex.zh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
ex.p: zài xīn jiā pō de jiē dào shǎng rēng lā jī huì bèi fá kuǎn
ex.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.

ex.zh: 山坡上有一间小屋。
ex.p: shān pō shǎng yǒu yī jiān xiǎo wū
ex.en: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.

ex.zh: 他向她求婚求了七次。
ex.p: tā xiàng tā qiú hūn qiú le qī cì
ex.en: He asked her seven times to marry him.

ex.zh: 我打算向她求婚。
ex.p: wǒ dǎ suàn xiàng tā qiú hūn
ex.en: I'm going to propose to her.

items.en: to tear down; to demolish; to dismantle
to taste a small amount; to sample

ex.zh: 你和你哥哥长得一模一样。
ex.p: nǐ hé nǐ gē ge cháng de yī mú yī yàng
ex.en: You look just like your big brother.

ex.zh: 有很多工人被困在煤矿里了。
ex.p: yǒu hěn duō gōng rén bèi kùn zài méi kuàng lǐ le
ex.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.

ex.zh: 我该在哪儿付煤气费？
ex.p: wǒ gāi zài nǎr fù méi qì fèi
ex.en: Where do I pay for the gas?

items.en: to draw support from; with the help of
to seize; to capture; to wrest control of

ex.zh: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。
ex.p: wǒ dì di shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè shè xiàng jī
ex.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.

ex.zh: 他不打算买一个摄像机。
ex.p: tā bù dǎ suàn mǎi yī gè shè xiàng jī
ex.en: He isn't going to buy a camera.

items.en: to fight a battle; to go to war

ex.zh: 他看起来健康强壮。
ex.p: tā kàn qǐ lai jiàn kāng qiáng zhuàng
ex.en: He appears to be strong and healthy.

items.en: to go out and come in; entrance and exit; expenditure and income
to differentiate; to draw a distinction; to divide into categories

ex.zh: 区分善恶不容易。
ex.p: qū fēn shàn ě bù róng yì
ex.en: It isn't easy to distinguish good from evil.

ex.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
ex.p: zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
ex.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.

items.en: preparations; to get ready for sth
to use anywhere, anytime (card, ticket etc)

ex.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
ex.p: yīng yǔ xiàn yǐ chéng wéi shì jiè shǎng xǔ duō guó jiā de tōng yòng yǔ yán le
ex.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.

items.en: to fish (with line and hook); to dupe

ex.zh: 比起出去钓鱼，我更想待在家里。
ex.p: bǐ qǐ chū qù diào yú wǒ gēng xiǎng dāi zài jiā lǐ
ex.en: I'd rather stay home than go fishing.

ex.zh: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。
ex.p: qián jī tiān rén shēng dì yī cì qù diào yú le
ex.en: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.

ex.zh: 我迫切需要冷饮。
ex.p: wǒ pò qiè xū yào lěng yǐn
ex.en: I'm dying for a cold drink.

items.en: to come into contact with; to have dealings

ex.zh: 我不喜欢跟人打交道。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan gēn rén dǎ jiāo dào
ex.en: I don't like to socialize.

items.en: to hold concurrent posts; concurrent job; moonlighting

ex.zh: 我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan chá suǒ yǐ wǒ zǎo cān dà zhì shǎng dōu hē kā fēi
ex.en: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.

ex.zh: 我大致上同意她。
ex.p: wǒ dà zhì shǎng tóng yì tā
ex.en: I generally agree with her.

items.en: the present age; the contemporary era
to catch; to seize; to capture

ex.zh: 我会向你展示怎样捕鱼。

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 6 · 第122单元

Literature

Grammar focus: Excerpts from public-domain modern writers (鲁迅, 朱自清); classical particles 之, 乎, 者, 也

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
sents.p: zài xīn jiā pō de jiē dào shǎng rēng lā jī huì bèi fá kuǎn
sents.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.

sents.zh: 山坡上有一间小屋。
sents.p: shān pō shǎng yǒu yī jiān xiǎo wū
sents.en: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.

sents.zh: 他向她求婚求了七次。
sents.p: tā xiàng tā qiú hūn qiú le qī cì
sents.en: He asked her seven times to marry him.

sents.zh: 我打算向她求婚。
sents.p: wǒ dǎ suàn xiàng tā qiú hūn
sents.en: I'm going to propose to her.

sents.zh: 你和你哥哥长得一模一样。
sents.p: nǐ hé nǐ gē ge cháng de yī mú yī yàng
sents.en: You look just like your big brother.

sents.zh: 有很多工人被困在煤矿里了。
sents.p: yǒu hěn duō gōng rén bèi kùn zài méi kuàng lǐ le
sents.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.

sents.zh: 我该在哪儿付煤气费？
sents.p: wǒ gāi zài nǎr fù méi qì fèi
sents.en: Where do I pay for the gas?

sents.zh: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。
sents.p: wǒ dì di shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè shè xiàng jī
sents.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.

sents.zh: 他不打算买一个摄像机。
sents.p: tā bù dǎ suàn mǎi yī gè shè xiàng jī
sents.en: He isn't going to buy a camera.

sents.zh: 他看起来健康强壮。
sents.p: tā kàn qǐ lai jiàn kāng qiáng zhuàng
sents.en: He appears to be strong and healthy.

sents.zh: 区分善恶不容易。
sents.p: qū fēn shàn ě bù róng yì
sents.en: It isn't easy to distinguish good from evil.

sents.zh: 只凭长相的话很难区分英国人和美国人。
sents.p: zhǐ píng zhǎng xiàng de huà hěn nán qū fēn yīng guó rén hé měi guó rén
sents.en: It's hard to tell Englishmen from Americans just by the way they look.

sents.zh: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。
sents.p: yīng yǔ xiàn yǐ chéng wéi shì jiè shǎng xǔ duō guó jiā de tōng yòng yǔ yán le
sents.en: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.

sents.zh: 比起出去钓鱼，我更想待在家里。
sents.p: bǐ qǐ chū qù diào yú wǒ gēng xiǎng dāi zài jiā lǐ
sents.en: I'd rather stay home than go fishing.

sents.zh: 前几天人生第一次去钓鱼了。
sents.p: qián jī tiān rén shēng dì yī cì qù diào yú le
sents.en: The other day I went fishing for the first time in my life.

sents.zh: 我迫切需要冷饮。
sents.p: wǒ pò qiè xū yào lěng yǐn
sents.en: I'm dying for a cold drink.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢跟人打交道。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan gēn rén dǎ jiāo dào
sents.en: I don't like to socialize.

sents.zh: 我不喜欢茶，所以我早餐大致上都喝咖啡。
sents.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan chá suǒ yǐ wǒ zǎo cān dà zhì shǎng dōu hē kā fēi
sents.en: I do not like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.

sents.zh: 我大致上同意她。
sents.p: wǒ dà zhì shǎng tóng yì tā
sents.en: I generally agree with her.

sents.zh: 我会向你展示怎样捕鱼。
sents.p: wǒ huì xiàng nǐ zhǎn shì zěn yàng bǔ yú
sents.en: I'll show you how to catch fish.

sents.zh: 他是个捕鱼好手。
sents.p: tā shì gè bǔ yú hǎo shǒu
sents.en: He is an expert at fishing.

sents.zh: 事情难免会发生。
sents.p: shì qing nán miǎn huì fā shēng
sents.en: Stuff happens.

sents.zh: 日本的人口密度很高。
sents.p: rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo
sents.en: Japan has a high population density.

sents.zh: 他时不时地因为工作去东京。
sents.p: tā shí bù shí de yīn wèi gōng zuò qù dōng jīng
sents.en: He sometimes goes to Tokyo on business.

sents.zh: 我时不时得到母亲的消息。
sents.p: wǒ shí bù shí dé dào mǔ qīn de xiāo xi
sents.en: I hear from my mother once in a while.

sents.zh: 这个房间很拥挤。
sents.p: zhè gè fáng jiān hěn yōng jǐ
sents.en: This room is cramped.

ex.zh: 你不明白流程。

items.en: invoice; receipt or bill for purchase
to have a surprise (idiom); shocked or startled; gobsmacked

ex.zh: 我觉得你真是让人大吃一惊。
ex.p: wǒ jué de nǐ zhēn shì ràng rén dà chī yī jīng

ex.p: tā kěn dìng huì dà chī yī jīng de

ex.en: The top of the mountain is covered in snow.

ex.p: cháng fā xiàn zài guò shí le
ex.en: Long hair is out of fashion now.

ex.p: tā men de xiǎng fǎ tài guò shí le
ex.en: Their way of thinking is behind the times.

lessons.title: 实惠、轮船、一帆风顺、浓厚…

sents.zh: 您能教我下国际象棋吗？
sents.p: nín néng jiāo wǒ xià guó jì xiàng qí ma
sents.en: Can you teach me to play chess?

sents.zh: 我对国际象棋不感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì guó jì xiàng qí bù gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I'm not interested in chess.

sents.zh: 她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。
sents.p: tā lì yòng kòng xián shí jiān zuò bù wá wa
sents.en: She spends her free time making dolls.

sents.zh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？
sents.p: nǐ kòng xián shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me
sents.en: What do you like doing in your free time?

sents.zh: 他岁数和你差不多。
sents.p: tā suì shu hé nǐ chà bù duō
sents.en: He is about your age.

sents.zh: 您父母多大岁数了？
sents.p: nín fù mǔ duō dà suì shu le
sents.en: How old are your parents?

sents.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。
sents.p: hù lián wǎng shì yī zhǒng wú fǎ gū liáng de xìn xī zī yuán
sents.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.

sents.zh: 我要另一片面包。
sents.p: wǒ yào lìng yī piàn miàn bāo
sents.en: I want another slice of bread.

sents.zh: 我早餐通常吃得很清淡。
sents.p: wǒ zǎo cān tōng cháng chī de hěn qīng dàn
sents.en: I usually have a light breakfast.

sents.zh: “酒水免费吗？”“仅女士而已。”
sents.p: jiǔ shuǐ miǎn fèi ma jǐn nǚ shì ér yǐ
sents.en: "Are the drinks free?" "Only for ladies."

sents.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。
sents.p: wǒ men lù shang yī fān fēng shùn zhí dào yù shàng bào fēng xuě
sents.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.

sents.zh: 我买了一支钢笔，但我把它丢了。
sents.p: wǒ mǎi le yī zhī gāng bǐ dàn wǒ bǎ tā diū le
sents.en: I bought a pen, but I lost it.

sents.zh: 我的钢笔不像你那支那么好。
sents.p: wǒ de gāng bǐ bù xiàng nǐ nà zhī nà me hǎo
sents.en: My pen isn't as good as yours.
